name: board_pass_soft8
_comment: Wave 7, U9 boarding speed gate, slow passes: pilot w7_bspeedsoft (Kit Crawler Soft: 44 px/s top speed, Accel 200, inertialess, so it keeps the speed of a short thrust tap). loops/board.mjs walks it to rest about 45 px from the 50,000 Kit Hulk (Down held 1.6 s to stop), aims, then a 230 ms tap (about 8 px/s) carries it over the hulk pressing b every 200 ms (pass_reads from the recording via planet_track.mjs --key b).
